sources.title: [2606.02800] Cosmos 3: Omnimodal World Models for Physical AI
sources.snippet: We introduce Cosmos 3, a family of omnimodal world models designed to jointly process and generate language, image, video, audio, and action sequences within a unified mixture-of-transformers architecture.
